entries.title: DOM-01: `Element::setInnerHTML` Buffer Pre-allocation

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: String materialization and HTML tokenizer state machine instantiation dwarf initial buffer allocation costs. The allocation is already handled efficiently by WTF `StringBuilder` exponential growth.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not attempt pre-sizing or capacity reservation optimizations for HTML parser input buffers.
entries.revisit_if: Do not attempt pre-sizing or capacity reservation optimizations for HTML parser input buffers.

entries.title: DOM-02: `HTMLCollection` Sequential Index Caching

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Blink already implements `CollectionItemsCache` and `CollectionIndexCache` inside `ContainerNode`. Adding an extra layer of index caching at the IDL wrapper level added redundant branch checks without avoiding tree walks.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add outer index/iterator caches to DOM collections; internal collection caches already optimize forward/backward traversal.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add outer index/iterator caches to DOM collections; internal collection caches already optimize forward/backward traversal.

entries.title: DOM-03: `Element::SetAttributeInternal` Redundancy Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Modern JavaScript UI frameworks (React, Vue, Preact, Lit) already maintain virtual DOM or template state and omit setting unchanged attributes in user-space script. The C++ check was evaluated on every legitimate attribute update where strings differed, adding string equality comparison overhead to every mutation.
entries.durable_invariant: Avoid adding duplicate-check branches to general DOM attribute setters. Frameworks already deduplicate in JS; C++ checks only penalize genuine mutations.
entries.revisit_if: Avoid adding duplicate-check branches to general DOM attribute setters. Frameworks already deduplicate in JS; C++ checks only penalize genuine mutations.

entries.title: DOM-04: `ContainerNode::NotifyNodeRemoved` Leaf Short-Circuit

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Blink's `ContainerNode::RemoveBetween` already batches removal notifications. Adding pre-removal checks on every individual child detachment added redundant branch evaluations without reducing work in batched removal routines.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add outer leaf-node guards to removal notification pipelines; batch removal routines (`RemoveChildren`, `RemoveBetween`) already optimize unparented and childless subtrees.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add outer leaf-node guards to removal notification pipelines; batch removal routines (`RemoveChildren`, `RemoveBetween`) already optimize unparented and childless subtrees.

entries.title: DOM-05: `ContainerNode::RemoveChildren` Batch Detachment

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Pre-unlinking child pointers disrupted Blink's unified layout tree detachment (`DetachLayoutTree`) and invalidated DOM tree structural invariants expected by subsequent MutationObserver notification scopes.
entries.durable_invariant: Never modify DOM tree sibling/parent pointers ahead of Blink's standard `Node::DetachLayoutTree` and `ContainerNodeWillBeRemoved` sequence.
entries.revisit_if: Never modify DOM tree sibling/parent pointers ahead of Blink's standard `Node::DetachLayoutTree` and `ContainerNodeWillBeRemoved` sequence.

entries.title: DOM-06: `SelectorQuery` Childless Container Bypass & `SpaceSplitString` Single-Class

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.measured_result: Sub-threshold suite delta `+0.18% [-0.21%, +0.58%]` ($t = 0.94$); zero stat-sig story wins.
entries.reason: While directionally positive in `TodoMVC-Backbone` (`+1.18%`), querying selectors against childless nodes is rare in modern frameworks. The per-call cycle savings were too small (<5 cycles) to cross statistical significance.
entries.durable_invariant: Selector query optimizations must address selector matching complexity (e.g. bloom filters or rule sharing) rather than trivial container empty checks.
entries.revisit_if: Selector query optimizations must address selector matching complexity (e.g. bloom filters or rule sharing) rather than trivial container empty checks.

entries.title: HTML-01: `HTMLInputElement::setValue` Redundancy Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Modern frameworks already track input state in JavaScript and only assign `input.value = ...` when the value has changed. The C++ string equality check added string length checks and character comparison overhead to every actual user keystroke/state update, causing mispredicted branches in ThinLTO builds.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add string equality guards to `HTMLInputElement::setValue` or similar form control value setters.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add string equality guards to `HTMLInputElement::setValue` or similar form control value setters.

entries.title: HTML-02: `HTMLFastPathParser::ParseAttributes` Empty Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.measured_result: Regressions across Svelte, Vue, and ES5.
entries.reason: Edge cases in HTML whitespace handling and entity decoding caused the fast-path parser to misclassify valid attributes or fail on trailing slashes, forcing expensive fallback to the full `HTMLDocumentParser`.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not alter tokenizer scanning or attribute slicing boundaries in `HTMLFastPathParser` without proving that fallback rates to the full parser remain strictly 0.00%.
entries.revisit_if: Do not alter tokenizer scanning or attribute slicing boundaries in `HTMLFastPathParser` without proving that fallback rates to the full parser remain strictly 0.00%.

entries.title: HTML-03: `DOMParser::parseFromString` Fast-Path

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: `DOMParser` creates an isolated implementation document and already routes directly into Blink's optimized parser pipeline. The DOMParser call frequency in Speedometer 3 is too low to produce measurable benchmark deltas.
entries.durable_invariant: Optimizations to `DOMParser` must prove significant call volume in target stories before investigation.
entries.revisit_if: Optimizations to `DOMParser` must prove significant call volume in target stories before investigation.

entries.title: EVT-01: `EventTarget::FireEventListeners` Single-Listener Bypass

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: In Chromium, the cost of event dispatch is dominated by V8 context switches, isolate entry, and script execution. Branching on vector size saved 1-2 CPU cycles inside C++, which was eclipsed by branch misprediction penalties on varied listener topologies.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add branch specializations for small vector sizes in `EventTarget::FireEventListeners`.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add branch specializations for small vector sizes in `EventTarget::FireEventListeners`.

entries.title: EVT-02: `EventPath` Non-Bubbling Event Allocation Bypass

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Even non-bubbling events must participate in capture phase dispatch and shadow boundary retargeting (WHATWG DOM § 2.8). Bypassing `EventPath` forced fallback paths and broke V8 inline caching for event dispatch trampolines.
entries.durable_invariant: `EventPath` construction is required for correct shadow DOM retargeting and capture dispatch; do not attempt to bypass it based solely on the `bubbles` flag.
entries.revisit_if: `EventPath` construction is required for correct shadow DOM retargeting and capture dispatch; do not attempt to bypass it based solely on the `bubbles` flag.

entries.title: LAY-01: `Element::RebuildLayoutTree` Pseudo-Element Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Pseudo-element layout attachment is tightly coupled with anonymous box generation. Skipping the pseudo-element rebuild check left child layout objects in a dirty state, triggering synchronous layout recalculation flushes during subsequent frames.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not skip pseudo-element attachment checks during `RebuildLayoutTree`; style-based dirty bits do not capture inherited anonymous box constraints.
entries.revisit_if: Do not skip pseudo-element attachment checks during `RebuildLayoutTree`; style-based dirty bits do not capture inherited anonymous box constraints.

entries.title: LAY-02: `Element::getBoundingClientRect` Viewport Caching

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Cache invalidation overhead on every DOM mutation, transform change, and ancestor scroll exceeded the cost of recalculating the bounding rect. Cache hit rate in interactive benchmarks was <15%.
entries.durable_invariant: Never introduce memoization caches for layout geometry coordinates without hardware-backed or layout-tree-versioned cache validation.
entries.revisit_if: Never introduce memoization caches for layout geometry coordinates without hardware-backed or layout-tree-versioned cache validation.

entries.title: LAY-03: `Element::GetBoundingClientRect` Single-Box Direct Quad Calculation

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Skipping the lifecycle layout update caused geometry queries to read stale coordinates whenever preceding script mutated DOM state. When layout updates were later forced by subsequent reads, the engine suffered pipeline stalls.
entries.durable_invariant: Geometry APIs (`getBoundingClientRect`, `offsetTop`, `offsetWidth`) must guarantee clean layout state; never bypass lifecycle updates to calculate geometry.
entries.revisit_if: Geometry APIs (`getBoundingClientRect`, `offsetTop`, `offsetWidth`) must guarantee clean layout state; never bypass lifecycle updates to calculate geometry.

entries.title: LAY-04: `LayoutBox` Non-Form Controls & Childless Containment

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.measured_result: Net suite drag of `-0.21% [-0.59%, +0.17%]`. Zero stat-sig wins.
entries.reason: `DefaultIntrinsicContentInlineSize` is already only called on boxes requiring intrinsic sizing. Adding polymorphic type checks (`IsFormControlElement`) and containment branches added evaluation cost across millions of box evaluations during layout passes without skipping measurable work.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add type-filter branches inside inner layout traversal algorithms unless profiling proves the non-target types dominate >50% of the inclusive time.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add type-filter branches inside inner layout traversal algorithms unless profiling proves the non-target types dominate >50% of the inclusive time.

entries.title: CSS-01: `CSSComputedStyleDeclaration` String Fast-Path

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Verifying that layout tree styles had not mutated required inspecting `ComputedStyle` generation IDs. The ID check plus atomic string hashing equaled the cost of the lightweight `CSSValue` materialization.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not attempt string-level caching on `CSSComputedStyleDeclaration`; the engine's `ComputedStyle` sharing already handles style memoization.
entries.revisit_if: Do not attempt string-level caching on `CSSComputedStyleDeclaration`; the engine's `ComputedStyle` sharing already handles style memoization.

entries.title: CSS-02: `EasySelectorChecker::Match` Subselector Bypass

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Subtle interactions with shadow DOM boundaries and `:host` / `:not()` pseudo-classes caused false-positive rule matches, forcing style invalidations and invalid cascade applications.
entries.durable_invariant: Selector matching shortcuts must be verified against 100% of WPT selector tests; partial shortcuts in `EasySelectorChecker` consistently produce style cascade bugs.
entries.revisit_if: Selector matching shortcuts must be verified against 100% of WPT selector tests; partial shortcuts in `EasySelectorChecker` consistently produce style cascade bugs.

entries.title: CSS-03: `NGShapeCache` 96-Char Buffer Expansion

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Larger keys increased hash table collision rates and cache memory footprint. In CodeMirror, code tokens are short (5–20 characters), so expanding the key length increased memory bandwidth without improving hit rates for real tokens.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not increase shape cache or text layout key lengths without proof that average token length in the target workload exceeds the existing boundary.
entries.revisit_if: Do not increase shape cache or text layout key lengths without proof that average token length in the target workload exceeds the existing boundary.

entries.title: CSS-04: `Seeker<T>::Seek` Empty Rule Intervals Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: `Seeker<T>::Seek` is inlined into the innermost loop of CSS rule set matching. In official ThinLTO/PGO2 builds, LLVM perfectly arranges binary branch targets. Adding an outer check introduced branch mispredictions and increased instruction cache footprint on every rule lookup.
entries.durable_invariant: Never add micro-branch guards or outer empty checks to tightly inlined template search helpers like `Seeker<T>::Seek`. In PGO builds, outer branches cause net regressions.
entries.revisit_if: Never add micro-branch guards or outer empty checks to tightly inlined template search helpers like `Seeker<T>::Seek`. In PGO builds, outer branches cause net regressions.

entries.title: CANV-01: `Canvas2DRecorderContext::DrawPathInternal` Full-Circle Arc to `drawOval`

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: In Skia's GPU playback pipeline, `drawOval` and `drawArc`/`drawPath` are serialized as different `PaintOp` types. Chart.js draws hundreds of circular markers in batch; converting full circles to ovals broke Skia's internal paint op batching, causing more draw calls and GPU state flushes.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not convert SkPath arcs to Skia ovals/rectangles without verifying Skia GPU op-merging and batching behavior; op-type diversity prevents batch draw call collapsing.
entries.revisit_if: Do not convert SkPath arcs to Skia ovals/rectangles without verifying Skia GPU op-merging and batching behavior; op-type diversity prevents batch draw call collapsing.

entries.title: CANV-02: `Canvas2DRecorderContext::setTransform` CTM Redundancy Check

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Redundant `setTransform` calls were exceedingly rare in the benchmark. The 6-float comparison (`AffineTransform` equality) executed on every valid transform change, adding pure CPU overhead without pruning work.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add matrix redundancy checks to Canvas 2D transform setters unless redundant calls exceed 60% of total invocations in profile traces.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add matrix redundancy checks to Canvas 2D transform setters unless redundant calls exceed 60% of total invocations in profile traces.

entries.title: SVG-01: `Document::createElementNS` SVG Tag Dispatcher

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: The hardcoded tag dispatch switch created branch table pressure and polluted branch target buffers when non-SVG or varied elements were created in rapid succession.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not replace Blink's atomic-string qualified name hash tables with hardcoded C++ `switch` statements for element creation.
entries.revisit_if: Do not replace Blink's atomic-string qualified name hash tables with hardcoded C++ `switch` statements for element creation.

entries.title: SVG-02: `CSSPathCache` 1-Entry MRU Cache

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.measured_result: Inaudible delta (`+0.21% [-0.25%, +0.67%]`); zero stat-sig wins across all 32 stories.
entries.reason: Speedometer SVG chart workloads (`React-Stockcharts-SVG`, `Charts-observable-plot`) render dynamic time-series charts where each data point has unique path coordinates. Sequential identical path strings are virtually nonexistent in timed loops.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not add 1-entry MRU caches for path or geometry strings without confirming temporal locality (repeated identical consecutive strings) in the target workload.
entries.revisit_if: Do not add 1-entry MRU caches for path or geometry strings without confirming temporal locality (repeated identical consecutive strings) in the target workload.

entries.title: FRAME-01: `LocalFrameView` Childless Traversal Bypass

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Frame traversal is responsible for triggering lifecycle callbacks, intersection observers, and resize observations in precise document order. Bypassing traversal disrupted callback ordering in multi-component custom element trees.
entries.durable_invariant: Do not bypass or reorder frame iteration in `LocalFrameView`; frame lifecycle ordering is strictly required for web observer notifications.
entries.revisit_if: Do not bypass or reorder frame iteration in `LocalFrameView`; frame lifecycle ordering is strictly required for web observer notifications.

entries.title: EDIT-01: `DomSelection::rangeCount` Layout Flush Bypass & Lazy Focus

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.reason: Skipping the layout update left the selection controller with un-updated layout positions. When subsequent DOM operations or events queried selection bounds, the engine was forced into delayed, high-latency synchronous layout recalculations.
entries.durable_invariant: Selection range queries must ensure clean layout; delaying layout flushes in selection queries causes cascading layout thrashing during event dispatch.
entries.revisit_if: Selection range queries must ensure clean layout; delaying layout flushes in selection queries causes cascading layout thrashing during event dispatch.

entries.title: NAV-01: `HistoryItem` Lazy Navigation API UUIDs

upper_bound.summary: pre-campaign leaf candidate (< 1% story bound; headless SwiftShader)

entries.measured_result: Flat delta (`-0.12%`); zero stat-sig wins across all 32 stories.
entries.reason: While Navigation API history items generate UUIDs on creation, Speedometer 3 stories execute inside pre-loaded single page applications where full navigation is not invoked during timed test runs.
entries.durable_invariant: Navigation API optimizations have zero impact on standard SPA benchmarks like Speedometer; verify that navigation lifecycles actually execute in the target benchmark before sizing.
entries.revisit_if: Navigation API optimizations have zero impact on standard SPA benchmarks like Speedometer; verify that navigation lifecycles actually execute in the target benchmark before sizing.
